lines: Donon jahan teri mohabbat mein haar ke
couplets.en: I lost both worlds for love of you.

lines: Woh ja raha hai koi shab-e-gham guzaar ke
couplets.en: There goes someone who has lived through a night of sorrow.

lines: Duniya ne teri yaad se begaana kar diya
couplets.en: The world has estranged me from the memory of you.

lines: Tujh se bhi dil-fareb hain gham-e-rozgaar ke
couplets.en: Even you are less beguiling than the cares of making a living.

lines: Woh ja raha hai koi shab-e-gham guzaar ke
couplets.en: There goes someone who has lived through a night of sorrow.

lines: Veeran hai maikada, khum-o-saaghar udaas hain
couplets.en: The tavern is deserted, and the wine jar and cup sit forlorn.

lines: Tum kya gaye ke rooth gaye din bahaar ke
couplets.en: When you left, even the days of spring turned away.

lines: Bhoole se muskura to diye the woh aaj, Faiz
couplets.en: Today, Faiz, they let a smile slip.
Do not ask what stirred in that unpractised heart.

lines: Donon jahan teri mohabbat mein haar ke
couplets.en: I lost both worlds for love of you.
